baselineDisplay.title: A Car Crash
baselineDisplay.question: Can the mechanics repair Mr. Wood's car?
baselineDisplay.questionZh: 修车师傅们能修好伍德先生的车吗？
baselineDisplay.text:
Can the mechanics repair Mr. Wood's car?

Is my car ready yet?
I don't know, sir.
What's the number of your car?
It's LFZ 312 G.
When did you bring it to us?
I brought it here three days ago.
Ah yes, I remember now.
Have your mechanics finished yet?
No, they're still working on it.
Let's go into the garage and have a look at it.
Isn't that your car?
Well, it was my car.
Didn't you have a crash?
That's right.
I drove it into a lamp-post.
Can your mechanics repair it?
Well, they're trying to repair it, sir.
But to tell you the truth, you need a new car!

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
我的车准备好了吗？
我不知道，先生。
您的车车牌号是多少？
车牌号是 LFZ 312 G。
您是什么时候把车送到我们这里的？
我三天前把车送到这里的。
啊，对了，我现在想起来了。
您的修车师傅们修好了吗？
不，他们还在修呢。
我们进去车库看看吧。
那不是你的车吗？
嗯，那辆车是我的。
你不是出车祸了吗？
没错。
我把车撞到路灯柱上了。
你们的机械师能修理它吗？
嗯，他们正在尝试修理它，先生。
但说实话，你真的需要一辆新车了！
